name: Post Covid World
storyline:
The pandemic was only the beginning.

As humanity fought to survive COVID-19, an unknown celestial force arrived on Earth. Its impact was not merely physical—it reshaped reality itself. Ecosystems evolved, civilizations collapsed, and across Latin America, something long buried began to awaken.

Ancient Aztec knowledge, forgotten civilizations, and forbidden myths resurfaced as a silent meteor storm altered the fabric of the world. What was once myth became power. What was once history became warfare.

In this new reality, ancient magic merges with cutting-edge technology. Weapons forged from lost civilizations coexist with advanced tactical systems, creating a battlefield unlike anything humanity has ever known.

At the center of this transformation lies the Highlander Arena—an infinite, shifting open-world battleground where reality bends, territories evolve, and warriors from across the world fight for dominance.

PostCovidWorld invites players into a vast open-world universe where survival, exploration, combat, and discovery converge. Traverse breathtaking environments across a transformed planet, uncover ancient secrets hidden beneath modern ruins, master diverse combat styles, and wield both technological and mythological power.

Every region holds forgotten history.
Every artifact carries a legacy of power.
Every battle reshapes the arena itself.

Only those who adapt—strategically, mentally, and spiritually—will rise above the chaos and claim the title of the ultimate Highlander.

Welcome to a world where the past and future are no longer separate.
summary:
Set in a large-scale open world inspired by a society rebuilding after a global pandemic, Highlander Arena invites players to freely explore a detailed environment featuring urban districts, commercial areas, industrial facilities, dynamic media surfaces, interactive locations, and immersive environmental storytelling.

Designed as both a gameplay sandbox and a foundation for future development, the arena showcases the visual direction, world-building philosophy, and core technologies that will power the full Post Covid World experience. Players can discover hidden details, navigate expansive locations, experience real-time digital displays, and witness the early evolution of a living world intended to grow over time.
